_comment: Illustrative excerpt of GET /api.json on a Pylon-Monitor device. Confirmed field paths: summary.soc, summary.voltage, summary.current, summary.power, summary.state, health.soh, net.rssi. The real response includes additional sections (per-cell voltages, per-battery breakdown for chained systems, temperatures, MQTT status) - see the live response on your own device's dashboard or https://pylon-monitor.com/tour for annotated screenshots.
